description: Links to OutletPicks listings matching a product description, lowest cost per unit (per ml, per diaper, per page, per lb) first, with the shelf each sits on. The pages show today's Amazon price, pack size and cost per unit; the tool returns links, not prices. Use for "what should X cost" and "is this a good price", then read the page.

query.description: Product words, e.g. "aa batteries" or "dove body wash 22 oz".

name: unit_price
title: Where a product is cheapest per unit
